This article describes how to organize your bookmarks with bookmark folders.
* For more information on using bookmarks, see [[Bookmarks in Firefox]].

__TOC__

= Making new folders =
#[[T:OpenBookmarksLibrary]]
# [[T:contextmenu]] on the folder which will contain the new folder, then select {menu New Folder...}. {for win,linux}<br><br>[[Image:how-to-create-a-new-bookmark-folder]]<br>{/for}
# In the New Folder window, type a name and (optionally) a description for the folder you want to create.

= Putting bookmarks into folders =
#[[T:OpenBookmarksLibrary]]
# Click on the folder that holds the bookmark you want to move.
# Drag the bookmark over the folder you want it moved to. Release the button to move the bookmark into the folder.

= Sorting folders =
For instructions on how to sort your bookmarks folders, see [[Sort your bookmarks to quickly find the ones you want]].
